Title: AI Infrastructure Engineer (LLM | GPU | AWS)
Location: Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai, Noida

Mandatory skills: 5+ yrs in Python, Pytorch, AWS Sagemaker, GPU, CUDA




Overview:

We are looking for AI Infrastructure Engineer with hands-on experience in deploying, fine-tuning, and optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs) in production environments.

You will work on designing high-performance ML infrastructure, optimizing GPU workloads, and enabling efficient model training and inference for enterprise-scale AI applications.




Key Responsibilities

Deploy and manage Large Language Models (LLMs) on AWS infrastructure.
Build and optimize training, fine-tuning, and inference pipelines using Amazon SageMaker.
Improve model performance through GPU optimization, CUDA programming, and kernel-level tuning.
Design scalable ML infrastructure for distributed training and inference workloads.
Work with NVIDIA GPUs (A100, H100) and AWS AI accelerators such as Trainium and Inferentia.
Optimize storage, networking, and compute resources for high-performance AI workloads.
Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across GPU, infrastructure, and distributed systems.
Benchmark model performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to design and deliver production-ready AI solutions.



Required Skills

5+ years of experience in Machine Learning Infrastructure, AI Platform Engineering, or GPU Computing.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
Experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying Large Language Models in production.
Strong understanding of CUDA, GPU architecture, and performance optimization.
Experience with distributed training across multiple GPUs or nodes.
Good understanding of AWS services including EC2 GPU instances, SageMaker, S3, EFS, VPC, and networking.
Experience designing scalable production ML systems.
Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and production deployment practices.



Interested candidates can apply here or share the resume to hr@lancetechsolutions.com
